title: An overspent budget line counts as nothing left in the walk; the overspend has already left the account (decision T4, final_review_3 finding 4, f4)
story: Set up Thu 10 Dec 2026, pay day: the bank holds 100,000, of which 40,000 is Food and 30,000 is Free to spend (typed). Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier) starts the period; rent of 120,000 on the 27th. On Sat 12 Dec a big shop for a party costs 50,000 of food: Food is 10,000 over. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 50,000 (bank today) - 0 (Food left: 10,000 over counts as nothing left) - 120,000 (rent 27 Dec) = -70,000
asks.note: Before T4 the walk took off Food's left of -10,000, adding it back: -60,000 (f4).

asks.question: headline
asks.why: none (the bank goes 70,000 below zero on Sun 27 Dec) = 0
